# Fixtures in this directory that are structurally valid per
# schemas/v1alpha1/jobspec.schema.json, but are rejected by
# v1alpha1.DecodeJobSpec because of a Go-only semantic rule that JSON Schema
# cannot express. See schemas/README.md for the full list of such rules.
#
# One file name per line. Comments start with '#'.

# xn-- (IDNA) labels are syntactically valid per the fqdn pattern; only
# internal/policy.NormalizeFQDN rejects them (ErrIDNALabel).
fqdn-xn--label.json

# The schema has no way to compare target.fqdn against
# policy.allowedDnsSuffixes; suffix membership is a Go-only cross-field
# check (internal/policy.Evaluate / MatchesSuffix).
fqdn-outside-suffix.json

# Label-boundary suffix matching ("evil-example.ac.jp" is not under
# "example.ac.jp") is a Go-only rule (internal/policy.MatchesSuffix); the
# schema only checks syntactic shape, not suffix membership.
fqdn-label-boundary-attack.json

# Whether a wildcard FQDN is allowed depends on policy.allowWildcard, a
# cross-field rule the schema cannot express.
wildcard-not-allowed.json

# An all-numeric top-level label is syntactically valid per the fqdn/suffix
# patterns (digits are in the allowed character class); only
# internal/policy.NormalizeFQDN rejects it (ErrNumericTLD).
fqdn-numeric-tld.json

# Duplicate top-level JSON object keys are syntactically valid JSON (the
# grammar does not forbid them) and are accepted by both json.Valid and the
# jsonschema library's decoder, which follow the common last-value-wins
# behavior. Only pkg/api/v1alpha1/decode.go's checkDuplicateKeys rejects
# this document.
duplicate-top-level-key.json
